issue: Off-by-one loop bound: `attempt < maxAttempts` starting at 1 performs only maxAttempts - 1 attempts, contradicting the parameter name.
suggestion: Use `for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++)` (or start at 0 with `attempt < maxAttempts`).

issue: The doc comment says the method returns null on failure, but the implementation throws InvalidOperationException; the comment is misleading.
suggestion: Replace with an accurate XML doc comment, e.g. /// <summary>Executes the operation, retrying up to <paramref name="maxAttempts"/> times; throws InvalidOperationException if all attempts fail.</summary>

issue: CA1822: Member 'Execute' does not access instance data and can be marked as static

CA1062: In externally visible method 'T RetryPolicy.Execute<T>(Func<T> operation, int maxAttempts)', validate parameter 'operation' is non-null before using it. If appropriate, throw an 'ArgumentNullException' when the argument is 'null'.
CA1031: Modify 'Execute' to catch a more specific allowed exception type, or rethrow the exception
Empty catch block silently swallows every exception, leaving no trace of the failure cause and hurting diagnosability.
suggestion: Capture the exception (e.g. `catch (Exception ex) when (...)`) and record it, then include it as the inner exception of the final InvalidOperationException.

issue: Class is named RetryPolicy but contains no delay/backoff between attempts, so the behaviour is a tight retry loop that the name does not convey.
suggestion: Either add a configurable delay/backoff parameter or rename to something like ImmediateRetryExecutor to match actual behaviour.
